title: About GallarDesign
description: GallarDesign is a one-person web studio in Cebu City run by Glen Gallarde. You see your website before you pay, and AI makes the build fast.
heading: An honest web studio in Cebu
intro: GallarDesign is a one-person studio in Cebu City run by Glen Gallarde. Glen designs every site, talks to every client and answers every change request.
paragraphs: Small businesses in Cebu are often asked for a deposit before they see anything, then wait, chase, and sometimes never get their files. GallarDesign works the other way around: we build your website first, and you pay only if you love it.

A real person leads every site, and AI drives the design and build work. That's why a preview takes 3 working days instead of months, and why the price can be fair. We tell you what AI did and what a person did.
Every price is on this website. Your domain is in your name, and your site, files and logins are yours the day you pay. Care is optional and month to month.
We want every small business to own its website, so there's a ₱4,990 Simple Page and a ₱0-down option. Each year we also build free websites for up to 4 qualified ministries.
Glen designed and built websites for businesses in Australia and the US, including Exit Advisory Group, Pre-Filters, RecovAdapt, Ridgeline Roofers, Brandon Insurance and the GAT Foundation.
GallarDesign also builds websites white label for agencies overseas, under the agency's name.
